description: This file sets up an Orleans host in a .NET application, configuring various options for grain placement rebalancing, including a background service that periodically pings a grain for testing purposes.

classes.name: LoadDriverBackgroundService
classes.description: A background service that periodically pings grains to simulate load or test rebalancing.

classes.name: RebalancingTestGrain
classes.description: A grain class that implements IRebalancingTestGrain and provides a Ping method.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Main loop of the background service that continually pings grains until cancellation.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Simple method in the grain interface and implementation that completes immediately.
